Birthday Wishes 💌

My dearest Sobia, today the world got a reason to smile, because today is the day you were born. 🌸 Happy Birthday to the girl who turned my ordinary days into beautiful memories.

You are not just my best friend. You are my comfort, my safe place and my favourite person to talk to about everything and nothing. With you, silence is peaceful, laughter is endless, and even the heaviest days feel lighter.

I will never forget our little moments: the silly pictures, the secret jokes, the long talks and the laughter that made our eyes water. They may look small, but they are my biggest treasures, and I would happily live every one of them again.

Thank you for standing beside me when I was weak, for listening without judging, for celebrating my happiness as if it were your own and for holding my hand through my tears. Whatever good there is in me today, a piece of you is in it. 🥹

On your special day, my heart prays that your life is filled with peace, health, success and endless reasons to smile. May every dream you carry quietly in your heart come true, may every door you knock on open for you, and may sadness never stay long at your doorstep.

May you always be surrounded by people who love you as sincerely as I do. You deserve soft mornings, happy hearts, beautiful surprises and a love that never lets you feel alone. 🤍

No matter how far life takes us or how busy we become, remember this: I am always just one message away. Your happiness will always matter to me, and our friendship will always be one of the best chapters of my life.

Happy Birthday, my beautiful Sobia. I love you more than words can ever say. ❤️

Your Bestie 🫶
